map.连接设计：按螺栓规格与强度等级校核拉伸或剪切应力是否满足: Connection design: verify tensile or shear stress against bolt size and strength grade.

map.算法：应力截面积 As 按规格查表（M6 20.1、M8 36.6、M10 58: Algorithm: stress area As from the size table (M6 20.1, M8 36.6, M10 58.0, M12 84.3, M14 115, M16 157, M18 192, M20 245, M22 303, M24 353, M27 459, M30 561 mm2); allowable tensile stress [sigma]=yield/safety; allowable shear [tau]=0.6 times yield/safety; actual sigma=F times 1000/As; actual tau=V times 1000/As. Tension case: sigma<=[sigma]; Shear case: tau<=[tau]; Combined case: sqrt((sigma/[sigma])^2+(tau/[tau])^2) <= 1. Utilization >85% warns of nearing the limit, >60% is economical, otherwise strength is ample.
map.例：M10、8.8 级（屈服 640MPa）、拉伸工况、F=20kN、安全系数: Example: M10, grade 8.8 (yield 640 MPa), tension, F=20 kN, safety factor 1.5 -> As 58.0 mm2, [sigma]=426.7 MPa, [tau]=256.0 MPa, sigma=344.8 MPa, utilization 80.8%, verdict: Pass, strength reasonable and design economical. If changed to M12 with combined loading F=30 kN, V=15 kN -> As 84.3 mm2, sigma=355.9 MPa, tau=177.9 MPa, sqrt((355.9/426.7)^2+(177.9/256)^2)=1.086 > 1, verdict: Fail, insufficient strength, upgrade to M16 (As 157 mm2, sigma=191.1, tau=95.5, combined 0.583, utilization 58.3%).
map.8.8 级的屈服强度为什么取 640MPa？: Why is the yield strength of grade 8.8 taken as 640 MPa?
map.8.8 级螺栓的公称屈服强度为 640MPa（即 8×8×10），抗拉强度 80: The nominal yield strength of a grade 8.8 bolt is 640 MPa (i.e. 8 times 8 times 10), and the tensile strength is 800 MPa. This tool uses the entered strength grade value directly as the yield stress, so for grade 8.8 enter 640, for grade 10.9 enter 900. GB/T 3098.1 gives the proof stress and yield strength for specific grades.
map.为什么没考虑预紧力和疲劳？: Why are preload and fatigue not considered?
map.本工具是简化静强度校核，只算外载荷产生的平均应力。实际受拉螺栓连接中预紧力会显著: This tool is a simplified static-strength check that only computes the average stress from the external load. In real tension joints the preload significantly changes the load sharing between bolt and clamped parts, and alternating loads require a fatigue check; critical joints should be calculated in detail per codes such as VDI 2230.
map.紧固件强度校核计算器根据螺栓规格（M6-M30）、强度等级（4.8-12.9级）: The fastener strength verification calculator checks whether a bolt meets the strength requirement under a given load based on bolt size (M6-M30), strength grade (4.8-12.9) and load state (tension/shear/combined), computing the stress utilization and giving design advice.
map.支持轴向拉伸、横向剪切、拉剪复合三种受力状态: Supports three load states: axial tension, transverse shear, combined tension-shear
